review.notes: Token-level alignment of the full OCR Markdown against extracted text from all 7 physical PDF pages in both directions; physical pages 4, 5 and 6 were rendered and visually inspected, with a 400 dpi crop of the benchmark-table image on p.4. The benchmark results table and the Methodology line beneath it exist only inside a table screenshot on p.4, so their OCR content (including the printed 'Methodology: deepmind.google/...' gray caption kept as body text) cannot be checked against the PDF text layer; the visible values match the rendered image. The safety-evaluation table on p.6 is real text and all five value rows match the rendered page (-8.14%, -0.92%, 0%, +3.04%, +5.32%). Two real drops were found (Distribution sentence continuation on pp.3-4 and the Tone footnote body on p.6) plus one misread digit inside the table image (128k read as 12Bk). No unbalanced code fences; headings match the PDF hierarchy; the Distribution bullet list, both tables and all section prose otherwise match.
